plan.title: Skill packs and project skills: fix stale docs, add pack authoring guide and config reference
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: Documentation sweep across independent doc pages: the subsystem counter treats every top-level doc file (features/x.mdx, cli/x.mdx, guides/x.mdx, …) as its own subsystem, so a one-issue docs fix spanning 12 pages and 3 skills exceeds 6 'subsystems' while touching 17 files and only one source line. Each item owns a disjoint file set; splitting into sibling issues would add pipeline overhead with no review benefit.

narratives.Problem: Skill packs work, but features/skills.mdx, docs/SKILL-PACKS.md, cli/skills-commands.mdx and docs/USAGE.md contain 17 verified mismatches with the code; there is no pack authoring guide, no config-key reference, no statement of which harnesses receive packs and project skills, and the pan handoff --pack help text omits that opt-in skills are skipped. Three skills use 'skill bundle' with conflicting meanings.
narratives.Proposal: Fix each mismatch in the page that holds it (one item per page), add guides/skill-pack-authoring.mdx and configuration/skills.mdx and list them in docs.json, correct the --pack help string and regenerate the composer manifest, update pan-skill-installer, pan-skill-creator and pan-sync, and make 'skill bundle' mean skill pack only. All facts and exact wording are in the PRD .pan/drafts/PAN-5064.md (F-1..F-24, decisions D-1..D-8).
narratives.NonGoals:
- Changing any skill, pack, launcher or override behavior; the only src/ change is the --pack help string in src/cli/index.ts
- Fixing the code defects found during research (project-skill copy gaps, issue-file overwrite on bad YAML, license detection gaps, stale comments, no-op multi-tool-sync); they are documented as current behavior and tracked as follow-up issues
- Adding a runtime warning when Pi receives --pack or --skill
- Editing changelog.mdx or .pan/drafts/PAN-4499.md, which contain the old help string as history
- Renaming the adjective 'bundled' or the phrase 'bundled resources'
- Renaming the Template Conversations proposal's `pan bundle` command or `skill-bundles/` path identifiers
- Letting custom packs declare opt-in skills, a plugin root or a skills root
- Restructuring features/skill-packs.mdx beyond the listed edits

autoDecisions.summary: Scope is docs plus the one --pack help string; code defects found in research are documented as current behavior and filed as follow-ups
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's acceptance criteria are documentation outcomes plus the help-text fix; widening into behavior changes would mix review concerns and violate the issue scope.

autoDecisions.summary: Authoring guide at guides/skill-pack-authoring.mdx (Guides nav); config reference at configuration/skills.mdx (Configuration nav, after context-layers)
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue calls the authoring page operator-facing how-to content, which matches the Guides tab; the issue asks for the config reference 'in configuration/'.

autoDecisions.summary: The noun 'skill bundle' means skill pack only; pan-sync uses 'skill directories', pan-skill-installer drops the 'bundle this plugin' trigger, and the Template Conversations proposal calls its group a 'skill set'
autoDecisions.rationale: features/skill-packs.mdx and template-conversations.mdx already define skill bundle as the operator synonym for skill pack, so aligning the other uses to it is the smallest change that yields one meaning.

autoDecisions.summary: Mismatch 17 wording: committed in the plan home on its checked-out branch (normally main) and pushed to that branch's upstream; push failure prints 'push pending: <reason>'
autoDecisions.rationale: commitPlanArtifacts commits on the plan home's current branch and pushPlanArtifacts pushes to its upstream (src/lib/overdeck/plan-artifact-commit.ts); skillsSetCommand prints the push-pending reason.

autoDecisions.summary: No mismatch is rejected; all 17 were confirmed against the code
autoDecisions.rationale: Each claim was verified by direct reads and two research passes; only the issue's directory for catalog.ts/store.ts etc. was wrong (they live in src/lib/skill-overrides/), which does not change the fixes.

autoDecisions.summary: Set plan.metadata.sizeJustification instead of splitting into sibling issues
autoDecisions.rationale: The quality lint counts each top-level doc file as a subsystem; the change is 17 files with disjoint ownership and one source line, so siblings would add overhead without reviewability gains.

autoDecisions.summary: Absorb PAN-4769 (two wording gaps in features/skill-packs.mdx) into skill-packs-page-fixes; PR closes #4769
autoDecisions.rationale: Both gaps are verified, sit in the same file this issue edits, and one is the same conversation-level gap as mismatch 15; separate PRs would conflict on the same lines.
